article:
Five sentences have been removed from the text below. For each question, choose the correct answer. There are three extra sentences which you do not need to use.
At home together
Taimi Taskinen is an 83-year-old woman who lives in a care home called Rudolf House in Helsinki, Finland. A care home is a place where old people can live and be looked after if they don't live with their families. At Rudolf House, there are lots of stairs, so there are some rooms which elderly people can't access easily. As a result, the city council decided to rent these spare rooms to young people. They called this new housing programme 'The House that Fits'.
When Taimi heard about the council's plan, she wondered how it was going to work. 16______ She couldn't imagine what she'd have in common with young people who weren't family members. Then, one morning a few days later, a young man appeared outside her room. 17______
'Hi! I'm your new neighbour,' the young man said. 'My name's Jonatan Shaya. Mind if I come in?' 'Please do,' she replied, immediately curious. 'I'll make coffee,' he announced, going into her tiny kitchen. 'Why don't you tell me about yourself?' he asked, as he brought their drinks to the table.
18______ She also told him about her family and how much she loved making art.
In turn, 20-year-old Jonatan told Taimi he'd been living in Helsinki with his mother and younger brother until they moved away. He was in the middle of a course in the city, training to become a chef. 19______ That's when he heard about 'The House that Fits' on social media. The council's post resulted in over 30 young people applying to live at Rudolf House. They had face-to-face interviews and wrote short essays about why they wanted to live there. 20______ And that's how the unlikely friendship between Taimi and Jonatan began.

sentences.label: A
sentences.text: Surprising herself, she talked about growing up in a lakeside town in eastern Finland.

sentences.label: B
sentences.text: Therefore, he needed to find somewhere to live.

sentences.label: C
sentences.text: As a result, she wasn't sure whether the young people had arrived.

sentences.label: D
sentences.text: She'd left the door open, as she always did in the morning.

sentences.label: E
sentences.text: In the end, three of them, including Jonatan, were chosen.

sentences.label: F
sentences.text: Because of this, Jonatan has to be a good neighbour and spend 30 hours a month with Taimi.

sentences.label: G
sentences.text: It would be the first time that anything like this had happened at Rudolf House.

sentences.label: H
sentences.text: Instead, they just talked, as if they'd known each other forever.

explanations.16: 前文提到Taimi对委员会的计划感到疑惑，G选项“It would be the first time that anything like this had happened at Rudolf House.”（这在Rudolf House是首次）解释了她疑惑的原因——项目的创新性，与“wondered how it was going to work”逻辑衔接。
explanations.17: 后文描述年轻人直接进入房间，D选项“She'd left the door open, as she always did in the morning.”（她像往常一样敞着门）为年轻人的进入提供了合理场景，符合“a young man appeared outside her room”的承接关系。
explanations.18: Taimi回应年轻人的提问，A选项“Surprising herself, she talked about growing up in a lakeside town...”（她意外地谈论起在湖边小镇的成长经历）与后文“told him about her family”形成具体事例支撑，符合对话逻辑。
explanations.19: Jonatan提到课程和搬家，B选项“Therefore, he needed to find somewhere to live.”（因此他需要找住处）解释了他申请项目的原因，与“heard about 'The House that Fits'”构成因果关系。
explanations.20: 前文提到30多人申请，E选项“In the end, three of them, including Jonatan, were chosen.”（最终包括Jonatan在内的三人被选中）呼应申请结果，引出两人友谊的开始，逻辑连贯。
